title: Yellowed Crunchy Malaysian Mascarpone Satay
description: A festive Malaysian dish featuring mascarpone and crunchy elements, perfect for special occasions, this dish is also nut-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Mix the mascarpone cheese, coconut milk, cornstarch, palm sugar, turmeric, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and mix until they are fully coated with the mascarpone mixture.
Thread the coated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and sprinkle with toasted sunflower seeds.
Bake the skewers in the oven for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the satay hot with additional toasted sunflower seeds on the side if desired.
Let the satay rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
